literal_meaning: ছত্রিশ জাতের কাণ্ড (thirty-six castes' mischief or antics)
example_sentences_in_bangla: বাজারে ছত্রিশজাতের কাণ্ড হয়ে গেল, সবাই ঠেলাঠেলি করছে।
সভায় ছত্রিশজাতের কাণ্ড শুরু হয়েছে, কেউ কথা শুনছে না।
example_sentences_in_english: The market turned into the mischief of thirty-six castes, with everyone pushing and shoving.
Chaos like the antics of thirty-six castes broke out in the meeting; no one was listening.
history: The phrase alludes to the diverse castes and communities in traditional Bengali society, implying widespread disorder from their collective actions.
note: Rooted in the social structure of Bengal with references to multiple castes causing trouble.
